data: Is the TEXT-LEVEL of the 'cause' domain the same as the TEXT-LEVEL of the 'approve' domain?

The question asks whether the TEXT-LEVEL of the 'cause' domain is the same as the TEXT-LEVEL of the 'approve' domain. From the provided information:

- The TEXT-LEVEL for the 'approve' domain is {0..4}.
- The TEXT-LEVEL for the 'cause' domain is {0.4}.

These two values are not the same. Therefore, the answer is no.
